dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a concave curvature with a deep, distinct triangular notch located approximately 40% of the distance from the apex to the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius, narrow rounded apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep, nearly linear anterior margin approximately 75 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 0.6:1 ratio of maximum longitudinal base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent V-shaped notch on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; numerous small, light-toned circular punctate marks on the visible flank skin surface.
